overview.title: Tunisian Healthcare System Overview
overview.description: Tunisia has a well-structured public hospital system that provides medical imaging and radiology services. Hospitals are categorized into district hospitals, regional hospitals, and university hospitals (CHU). Services range from basic X-rays and ultrasound to advanced CT scans, MRI, PET-CT, and interventional radiology. The public healthcare sector represents more than 80% of hospital beds nationwide. Each governorate has at least one regional hospital equipped with radiology services, while large cities like Tunis, Sousse, Monastir, and Sfax host university hospitals with advanced technologies.

mri.name: MRI

pet_ct.description: Specialized nuclear imaging available at select centers.
pet_ct.notes: At Salah Azaïez Institute in Tunis

interventional_radiology.name: Interventional Radiology
interventional_radiology.description: Advanced medical procedures using imaging guidance.

district.title: District Hospitals
district.description: Basic imaging services: X-ray and ultrasound. Serve rural areas and small towns.

regional.title: Regional Hospitals
regional.description: Broader range of services: X-ray, ultrasound, CT scan, mammography. At least one per governorate.

university.title: University Hospitals (CHU)
university.description: Full range of radiology services: CT, MRI, PET-CT (oncology), interventional radiology, training & research. Mainly in Tunis, Sousse, Monastir, and Sfax.
